sub_agent_reviews.summary: One merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety; SAO ranked first after current-week date checks and exact local dedupe.
Full arXiv PDF and HTML were read; article extracts method, formulas, training setup, benchmarks, ablations, figures, appendix limits, and safety boundary.
External references included arXiv submission history, arXiv HTML full text, Hugging Face paper listing, and paper-cited asynchronous RL baselines.
Markdown uses TL;DR, h3 sections, tables, formula blocks, pseudocode, and Mermaid; no external image URLs were embedded.
